name: SP3ND
description: Create server-priced shipped-product and Collector Crypt card orders, pay with USDC on Solana, and track fulfillment. SP3ND manually purchases paid Collector Crypt cards and transfers the NFT to the buyer wallet.
tldNote: Use a marketplace URL appropriate for the recipient, and always send the complete final destination when creating the order. eBay pricing and shipping are destination-dependent. Collector Crypt-only orders omit shipping and use asset_recipient_wallet.

authentication.description: Register with POST /registerAgent. Include X-API-Key and X-API-Secret on authenticated requests.

lifecycle.paymentGate: Only pay when payment_ready is true. Canonical current orders use pricing_status ready_for_payment; quoted is a deprecated legacy value and never makes an order payable by itself.
lifecycle.manualReview: Mixed or unverified carts remain one Awaiting Review order with checkout_role manual_review, pricing_status awaiting_team_quote, requires_manual_quote true, and payment_ready false.
lifecycle.requiredTransition: An Awaiting Review order must reach Ready for Payment before Paid. Ready for Payment means the payment gate passes, the quote is current, and any required shipping option is selected.
lifecycle.quoteSafety: Honor quote_revision, quote_expires_at, shipping_options, selected_shipping_option_id, and selected_shipping_option. Refresh expired or changed quotes.
lifecycle.shippingCompatibility: Canonical options use shipping_option_id and canonical selections expose selected_shipping_option_id plus selected_shipping_option. Legacy id and selected_manual_shipping_option values may appear only for compatibility.
lifecycle.pricingAuthority: SP3ND resolves product data and payment requirements. Caller-provided prices, totals, currency, recipient, and memo are not authoritative.
lifecycle.walletAttribution: Send user_wallet for end-user history and points attribution.
lifecycle.assetDelivery: Collector Crypt orders use a fixed asset_recipient_wallet and manual fulfillment. Paid confirms SP3ND treasury receipt only and queues pending_acquisition for SP3ND's manual operations team. Authorized operations must verify the wallet transfer and atomically record delivered fulfillment metadata and transfer evidence with top-level status Delivered; clients use that top-level status as the completion gate. A claim mismatch uses review_required, and a sold or changed listing may require manual handling and a refund.
lifecycle.paymentFlow: For Collector Crypt orders use partnerPayment prepare/submit only; createPartnerTransaction and payAgentOrder reject real cards. Supported non-card agentic-skill orders retain the payAgentOrder x402 flow. Do not chain payment surfaces.

skills.name: Register Agent
skills.description: Register an agent and receive API credentials.

skills.name: Create Server-Priced Cart
skills.description: Create a server-priced cart from shipped-product URLs or one Collector Crypt asset. Display metadata and prices supplied by callers are non-authoritative.

items.description: Products to resolve and price on the server.

product_url.description: Canonical Amazon/eBay HTTPS product URL, a supported Amazon/eBay product-share link, or an exact https://collectorcrypt.com/assets/solana/<asset-address> URL.

provider.description: Use with nft_address instead of product_url for a Collector Crypt card.

nft_address.description: Exact Collector Crypt Solana asset address; requires provider=collectorcrypt.

quantity.description: Physical products follow normal cart bounds. Collector Crypt assets require exactly 1 and one card per cart.

user_wallet.description: Optional valid on-curve Solana wallet saved on the cart. createPartnerOrder uses it when the order request omits user_wallet; the final Collector Crypt buyer and asset-recipient wallets must still resolve identically.

skills.name: Create Lifecycle-Aware Order
skills.description: Create one idempotent order from a cart. Shipped products require a complete shipping address. A Collector Crypt-only cart omits shipping and resolves user_wallet plus asset_recipient_wallet to the same buyer wallet; gifting is unsupported. Approved Partners may create and pay card orders without separate opt-in; confirmed payment queues SP3ND's manual purchase and wallet delivery.

Idempotency-Key.description: Stable key for this intended checkout. Supply this header or the idempotency_key body field, and reuse it for retries.

idempotency_key.description: Stable key supplied in the body instead of the Idempotency-Key header. If both are present, use the same value.

user_wallet.description: End-user Solana wallet. For Collector Crypt it resolves to the asset recipient; send both wallet fields identically.

shipping_address.description: Complete final destination required for shipped-product carts. Omit for a Collector Crypt-only cart.

asset_recipient_wallet.description: Collector Crypt delivery wallet. It must resolve to the same valid on-curve address as user_wallet; gifting is unsupported and a mismatch is rejected.

skills.name: Get One Order
skills.description: Read an order and its schema v2 quote, payment-readiness, and fulfillment fields.

skills.name: List Orders
skills.description: List authenticated partner orders. Omit status to return all orders (recommended); status=all is also supported for compatibility.

status.description: A real named status such as Created, Awaiting Review, Paid, Ordered, Shipped, or Delivered. Omit for all (recommended), or use all for compatibility.

skills.name: Select Order Shipping Option
skills.description: Select an opaque option from the order's current shipping_options. The server enforces quote revision and expiry.

skills.name: Pay Payment-Ready Order via x402
skills.description: Call only when payment_ready is true, the quote is current, and any required shipping option is selected. Canonical current orders use pricing_status ready_for_payment; quoted is deprecated legacy compatibility. Payment fields come from the server's 402 response. Collector Crypt orders are unsupported and must use partnerPayment prepare/submit.

skills.name: Register Manual Payment Transaction
skills.description: Register payment intent for a payment-ready order. Caller amount, currency, memo, and recipient fields are ignored; use server-returned instructions. Collector Crypt orders are unsupported and must use partnerPayment prepare/submit.

skills.name: Agent Status
skills.description: Return agent registration and operational status.

skills.name: Search Collector Crypt Cards
skills.description: Search eligible native-Solana Collector Crypt V2 buy-now listings with supported token standards and cent-denominated USDC prices. Upstream counts precede local eligibility filtering and may exceed items.length. createPartnerCart refetches the exact asset and establishes the authoritative quote.

q.description: Optional substring card/item-name search or exact NFT-address/grading-ID lookup. Omit to browse.

cursor.description: Opaque, nonblank next_cursor returned unchanged; control characters are rejected; takes precedence over page.

skills.name: Prepare Collector Crypt Payment
skills.description: Prepare one server-authoritative, immutable, expiry-bound Solana USDC transaction for a payment-ready Collector Crypt order. Payment goes to SP3ND and queues manual acquisition and wallet delivery after confirmation; it does not itself deliver the card.

payer_address.description: Valid Solana address that must match the order wallet and sign the exact returned transaction.

skills.name: Submit Collector Crypt Payment
skills.description: Submit only the exact wallet-signed serialization from the matching prepare response. On an unknown result, read the order and retry only those identical signed bytes; never rebuild or re-sign.

signed_transaction_base64.description: Exact signed transaction returned by the matching prepare action; never rebuilt or modified.

collectorCryptContract.recipientRule: payer_address, user_wallet, and asset_recipient_wallet must resolve to the same valid on-curve Solana wallet; gifting is unsupported.

searchResponseMetadata.note: listing_price_usdc is the live cent-denominated listing amount mirrored by generic price. Returned items have a supported token_standard. Upstream totals, pages, and category counts are computed before SP3ND local eligibility filtering and may exceed items.length. Insured value and timestamps are informational; createPartnerCart refetches the asset and establishes the authoritative quote.

collectorCryptContract.paidMeaning: SP3ND treasury receipt confirmed; provider purchase and wallet delivery remain pending.
collectorCryptContract.queueMeaning: After confirmed payment, pending_acquisition means a server-only job is queued for SP3ND's manual operations team to purchase the exact card and transfer it to the fixed buyer wallet. No automatic purchase or transfer occurs; queueing is not delivery.
collectorCryptContract.availabilityRisk: The listing may sell or change before SP3ND purchases it, requiring manual handling and potentially a refund.
collectorCryptContract.discoveryCapabilityMeaning: Derived true after normal approved-Partner authentication, not a stored setting.
collectorCryptContract.fulfillmentEvidence: Confirmed transaction references plus authorized operator attestations; delivery also checks current asset ownership. These checks do not cryptographically prove that a referenced transaction caused the specific purchase or asset transfer.

collectorCryptPartnerPayment.description: Collector Crypt wallet payment is available to approved Partners without separate opt-in. Prepare one immutable, expiry-bound transaction, sign its exact bytes with payer_address, submit only that exact signed serialization, and poll the order. Confirmed USDC payment queues manual purchase and wallet delivery by SP3ND; Paid is not delivery.
collectorCryptPartnerPayment.prepareIdempotency: An unchanged safe replay returns the same unsigned_transaction_base64 with idempotent_replay=true.
collectorCryptPartnerPayment.submitIdempotency: On an unknown outcome, read the order and retry only the identical signed_transaction_base64. Never rebuild, re-sign, or prepare a replacement while unknown.
